title: Plein-Air Studies by Laurits Tuxen
content: Here's a group of plein-air studies byLaurits Tuxen(Danish, 1853-1927)Like most artists of his era, he painted studies during his travels to the Holy Land. He kept these studies as possible reference for his studio paintings.-----Previously:Valdemar by TuxenWikipedia onLaurits Tuxen
